infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: AuroraSense records magnetic field and motion only during a foreground observation you start.

plugins.motionPermission: AuroraSense uses motion to check the quality of your consented foreground magnetic recording.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: AuroraSense uses your foreground location to select aurora evidence and nearby professional magnetometers. Precise coordinates stay on your device.
